label: final copy output step of length-3 sequences
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase. About 78% of activation mass comes from the last step (t=5, outputting orig(2), input = orig(1)) of L=3 sequences, where roughly 70% of such steps are active; all top activations are of this type (e.g. c 2 m <DEL> c [2]). Magnitude is higher when the input there is 2, j, g or 0 and lower for inputs like o, h, t, s. The rest is weak, scattered activity on the last or second-to-last copy steps of longer sequences (e.g. t=17 for L=9, t=11-13), again favouring inputs 2/g/j/0. Never fires in the original or delimiter phases, or on first occurrences of a token.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token (most: 2, 0, g, j, l, i; least: m, s, a, v) and the previous input (most: j, b, y, r, l, c; least: f, p, <DEL>, o); timing cues that raise it most: L=3 & t=5, L=3, t=5.
